notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 18336). The only Steam store match is app 202750 (schema name is the placeholder "ValveTestApp202750"). It has only 12 achievements, none hidden; their display names are full sentences and the descriptions repeat them in the past tense. Four story achievements give the story chapter; the rest are Arcade Mode, manuscript pages and combat. StrategyWiki has no page for "Alan Wake's American Nightmare"; "Alan Wake: American Nightmare" was also tried and is missing too. alanwake.fandom.com answers the API with about 52 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
